An ongoing project to build visualizations for mathematical concepts as a tool for
teaching and learning. The goal is to make mathematics more accessible and engaging for
students at all levels --- from a first calculus course through to graduate topics.

Each visualization is designed to be self-contained: drop it into a lecture, a problem set,
or a student's own exploration without any setup.
